jamal: quick handoff note — I'm primary for the US night shift until 03:00 UTC. priya is secondary and covers EU crossover from 23:45–00:30 UTC. there's a hole in EU warmhandoff between 00:00–00:15 UTC if no one picks up. please ack if you can cover that slot.

priya: acked — I can take 00:00–00:15 if jamal needs to step away for the maintenance window. leaving a sticky reminder in the handoff doc. :white_check_mark:

jamal: thanks. two quick reminders: 1) if you see a sustained token-latency > 1s P95 for > 5m, treat as potential customer-impacting and escalate per rules below; 2) if an incident-bot page comes with "model-serving-error" + >5% errors in 5m, escalate immediately to oncall-lead.

incident-bot: Pager: model-serving-error (channel: eng-oncall) — triggered at 2024-06-01T01:42:11Z — error-rate 6.3% over 5m — route: primary oncall.

miguel: I see the bot alert. quick practical checklist for this thread (copy to runbook):
1) confirm customer impact: check /metrics/token-errors and /dash/latency (5m window).
2) if customer-facing errors or >5% failure, page L2 + oncall-lead immediately.
3) run quick mitigation: `curl -X POST https://ops.example/restart-worker -d '{"pool":"gen-large"}'` (only if KV cache is stale and we have elevated OOMs).

alice: adding escalation rules here to be explicit (from runbook):
- SEV1 (complete outage / >25% customers affected / revenue-affecting): page primary, then page oncall-lead (@alice), then page SRE rotation and on-call manager. If not acked in 5m escalate to exec-ops.
- SEV2 (degraded experience, increased latency or errors affecting a segment): page primary and oncall-lead; open bridge; keep PMs informed.
- SEV3 (minor, internal): handle async, notify stakeholders on Monday if persisted.

alice: paging procedure: always include `incident-id`, `impact-summary`, and `top-suspected-cause` in the first message. Example: `INC-20240601-42 — 6.3% token error, affected gen-large pool, suspected KV cache corruption`. If you page SRE lead, add `pager:escalate-5m` so they know to respond fast.

lina: from product side, please ping me (lina) for any customer-facing incidents hitting >100 customers or any API key failures — we need to coordinate status page + comms.

jamal: runtime mitigation notes (short):
- try rolling 1/3 of gen-large workers to pick up kv-cache warm reload.
- if errors spike after rolling, revert and route traffic to smaller model-fallback.
Code snippets: 
```
# roll 1/3 workers in pool
for i in 1 2 3; do ops roll --pool gen-large --fraction 0.33 --wait 120; done
```

priya: runbook pointers: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-serving.md#kv-cache-reload and https://redwood.internal/playbooks/oncall-escalation.md — I left a short checklist on the first doc for the EU crossover.

sre-bot: NOTE: runbook edit requested by priya at 2024-06-01T01:50Z — added EU-crossover note.

jamal: decision log from this thread: priya will cover 00:00–00:15 EU slot; miguel to kick off a 1/3 roll if errors keep >5% for 10m; lina on comms if customers >100 affected. I'll page alice if we see SEV1 indicators.

priya: ack, and leaving a short handoff message in #general so other teams know the small gap is covered. :wave:

miguel: I'll monitor dashboards for next 30m and update here if any mitigation actions run. leaving a quick reminder: page oncall-lead for any unknown error-type — don't try multiple roll attempts without L2 approval.

jamal: thanks everyone. closing the handoff thread — keep this channel for live updates only. if anything changes ping me directly. :lock:
